stem: What is the effect of the figurative language in this sentence?
instruction:
Read this sentence from paragraph 8.

She held her breath and walked more softly, almost sneaking up on the books that awaited her.

options.label: A
options.text: It emphasizes Carol's sense that something out of the ordinary awaits her.

options.label: B
options.text: It suggests that Carol's imagination is driving her actions.

options.label: C
options.text: It creates an atmosphere of menace around the library.

options.label: D
options.text: It contrasts the library with the comfort of the other parts of the house.

visual_elements: She held her breath and walked more softly, almost sneaking up on the books that awaited her.
